set -Eeuo pipefail

echo "== step 1: install packages =="
sudo -n dnf install -y nginx policycoreutils-python-utils >/tmp/dnf-install.log 2>&1 && tail -5 /tmp/dnf-install.log

echo "== step 2: selinux port label for 8443 =="
sudo -n semanage port -a -t http_port_t -p tcp 8443 || sudo -n semanage port -m -t http_port_t -p tcp 8443
semanage port -l | grep -w 8443

echo "== step 3: firewall =="
sudo -n firewall-cmd --add-port=8443/tcp --permanent
sudo -n firewall-cmd --reload
firewall-cmd --list-ports

echo "== step 4: cert directories =="
sudo -n mkdir -p /etc/nginx/tls
sudo -n chown root:root /etc/nginx/tls
sudo -n chmod 750 /etc/nginx/tls

echo "== step 5: renewal script =="
sudo -n tee /usr/local/sbin/renew-cert.sh > /dev/null <<'EOS'
#!/bin/sh
set -eu

CERT_DIR=/etc/nginx/tls
KEY=$CERT_DIR/server.key
CRT=$CERT_DIR/server.crt
CN="${NODE_NAME:-node1}"
IP="${NODE_IP:-127.0.0.1}"
DAYS=30
RENEW_WINDOW_SECONDS=$((15*24*3600))
FORCE="${RENEW_FORCE:-0}"

need_renew=1
if [ -s "$CRT" ] && [ "$FORCE" != "1" ]; then
  if openssl x509 -in "$CRT" -checkend "$RENEW_WINDOW_SECONDS" -noout >/tmp/renew-check.log 2>&1; then
    need_renew=0
  fi
fi

if [ "$need_renew" = "0" ]; then
  echo "cert still valid beyond renewal window, skipping"
  exit 0
fi

TMP_KEY=$(mktemp "$CERT_DIR/.server.key.XXXXXX")
TMP_CRT=$(mktemp "$CERT_DIR/.server.crt.XXXXXX")

openssl req -x509 -newkey rsa:2048 -keyout "$TMP_KEY" -out "$TMP_CRT" \
  -days "$DAYS" -nodes -subj "/CN=$CN" \
  -addext "subjectAltName=IP:$IP,DNS:$CN,DNS:localhost" \
  -addext "basicConstraints=CA:FALSE" >/tmp/renew-openssl.log 2>&1

chmod 640 "$TMP_KEY" "$TMP_CRT"
chown root:root "$TMP_KEY" "$TMP_CRT"

mv -f "$TMP_KEY" "$KEY"
mv -f "$TMP_CRT" "$CRT"

echo "renewed cert: $(openssl x509 -in "$CRT" -noout -serial -enddate)"

if systemctl is-active --quiet nginx; then
  nginx -t
  systemctl reload nginx
  echo "nginx reloaded"
fi
EOS
sudo -n chmod 750 /usr/local/sbin/renew-cert.sh
sudo -n chown root:root /usr/local/sbin/renew-cert.sh

echo "== step 6: systemd service + timer =="
sudo -n tee /etc/systemd/system/cert-renew.service > /dev/null <<EOS
[Unit]
Description=Renew self-signed HTTPS certificate for nginx on 8443

[Service]
Type=oneshot
Environment=NODE_NAME=$NODE_NAME
Environment=NODE_IP=$NODE_IP
ExecStart=/usr/local/sbin/renew-cert.sh
EOS

sudo -n tee /etc/systemd/system/cert-renew.timer > /dev/null <<'EOS'
[Unit]
Description=Daily timer to check/renew HTTPS certificate before expiry

[Timer]
OnBootSec=2min
OnUnitActiveSec=1d
RandomizedDelaySec=5min
Persistent=true
Unit=cert-renew.service

[Install]
WantedBy=timers.target
EOS

sudo -n systemctl daemon-reload

echo "== step 7: initial cert issuance (force) =="
sudo -n env NODE_NAME="$NODE_NAME" NODE_IP="$NODE_IP" RENEW_FORCE=1 /usr/local/sbin/renew-cert.sh

echo "== step 8: nginx vhost on 8443 =="
sudo -n tee /etc/nginx/conf.d/https-8443.conf > /dev/null <<'EOS'
server {
    listen 8443 ssl;
    server_name _;

    ssl_certificate     /etc/nginx/tls/server.crt;
    ssl_certificate_key /etc/nginx/tls/server.key;

    ssl_protocols TLSv1.2 TLSv1.3;

    location / {
        return 200 "ok\n";
        add_header Content-Type text/plain;
    }
}
EOS

sudo -n nginx -t
sudo -n systemctl enable --now nginx
sudo -n systemctl enable --now cert-renew.timer

echo "== step 9: verify =="
systemctl is-active nginx

openssl x509 -in /etc/nginx/tls/server.crt -noout -serial -enddate -subject
echo "DONE"
